instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: KeyHarbor Dispatch Clearance coordinates pool-vehicle trips from request through return. Trip Requesters provide journey purposes and required travel dates, Fleet Allocators assign available vehicles, Safety Inspectors complete pre-trip checks and record clearance decisions, Key Custodians control key handover and record key receipt and return, and Assigned Drivers record vehicle returns. Competing-request ranking and checklist contents remain unresolved, while fuel purchasing is excluded.

output.summary: KeyHarbor Dispatch Clearance coordinates pool-vehicle trips from request through return. Trip Requesters provide trip details, Fleet Allocators assign available vehicles, Safety Inspectors complete pre-trip checks and record clearance decisions, Key Custodians control and record key custody, and Assigned Drivers record vehicle returns. Competing-request ranking and checklist contents remain unresolved, and fuel purchasing is excluded.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate pool-vehicle trips from request through return.
key_capabilities: Collect journey purposes and required travel dates.
Complete pre-trip checks and record clearance decisions.
Control key handover and record key receipt and return.
unresolved_points: How competing trip requests should be ranked.
Which items the pre-trip checklist must contain.
